lines.label: B1
lines.reason: The tab fold is about 90 deg (included angle 89.2 deg). Sections at 25/50/75% put the apex on the outer arc, with the nearest scan point 0.15-0.17 mm away; the inner skin sits about 1.9 mm inside, which matches the 1.93 mm thickness. The line is parallel to the fold. The outer arc runs about 13.9 mm along the line, from the free left edge to the relief slot, and the 13.35 mm line covers about 96% of it. Patch 5 is the cut end face of the fold and is not a flange.
